title: Tiered seating area with several people, backpacks and a small safety sign
objects_and_counts: At least seven people are visible in the photographed scene: three seated on the mid-right tier (two males in dark clothing and one person partly obscured behind them), one woman seated on a lower tier facing right, one person wearing a cap and one person with glasses in the upper-left background, and two partially visible heads at the bottom and right edge; several of these are cropped or partially obscured.
One blue laptop is visible on the lap of the seated man on the mid-right tier; it is open and being held with both hands.
One large black backpack is visible on the left bench surface, against the riser; a second black bag with a geometric pattern is visible beneath the mid-right seating area.
One small rectangular sign is affixed to the vertical face of a bench riser at left (near the large black backpack).
One pair of brown sandals is visible on the feet of the seated man on the mid-right tier.
Multiple seating tiers/steps (at least three horizontal bench levels) form the fixed seating; a glass panel and a white diagonal balustrade are visible behind the seated people.
spatial_relations: People are arranged on tiered bench seating: a lower tier at front where a woman in a light jacket sits facing right, a mid tier where two men sit side-by-side facing right, and an upper tier at left where two people are standing or seated near the back.
A large black backpack rests on the horizontal surface of the left bench, immediately above the small safety sign affixed to the vertical face of that bench riser.
A white diagonal balustrade runs upward from lower right to upper center-right behind the seated individuals and a glass panel fills the background above and behind the balustrade.
A patterned black bag is located beneath the mid-right seating level, roughly under the knees of the seated man with the blue laptop.
Two partially visible heads occupy the lower foreground and lower right edge of the image in front of the lower tier seating.
colours_and_materials: Bench and riser surfaces appear light grey or pale wood-toned; the vertical riser faces are pale grey.
A black fabric backpack and a black patterned bag are visible; the blue laptop has a bright blue cover.
The diagonal balustrade and surrounding trim are white; the large background paneling and walls are a pale grey-green.
The seated woman's jacket is an off-white or cream textured fabric; one pair of sandals is brown leather or leather-like material.
uncertainties: Exact total number of people in the scene cannot be determined precisely because some heads are partly cropped or obscured behind others; I report a minimum of seven visible individuals.
